status: Frozen before first numerical execution; no post-result change to library, seeds, scores or gates
purpose: Bracket prediction-oriented loading-design headroom in a finite physically defined library before developing a new adaptive algorithm
scope: Synthetic exploratory design screen; standard set-membership minimax design, not a novelty or real-material claim
noise_assumption: Independent uniform observations with exactly known amplitude for this first favorable feasibility screen; independent amplitude calibration is deferred
candidate_library: 18 schedules: 32 fresh ramp_hold observations plus 32 fresh observations on each of six histories, both using each of three sampling rules
objective: Minimize max_j D_j(schedule)/utility_limit_j, where D_j is the worst possible posterior target diameter conditional on the observed pilot, over all bounded-error future outcomes
pair_constraint: Two pilot-compatible spectra must differ by at most 2*b in every proposed future observation; continuous outer relaxation additionally allows the sum of both mass-weighted curvature remainders
headroom_requirement: At least two of four truth groups, including continuous_uniform, have mean selected outer normalized diameter <=0.9 times mean fixed-baseline inner normalized diameter
validation_requirements: All selected and comparator posterior intervals contain their supported true targets
Every finite-grid pair lower bound is <= its continuous outer upper bound
Pilot and confirmation streams are disjoint; design selection does not read confirmation outcomes or true parameters
Replay all saved LP primal witnesses and floating-point dual objectives/residuals
stopping: If the headroom gate fails, do not tune this library or objective from outcomes; distinguish absence of 10% headroom proven within this finite library from unresolved numerical brackets and from untested loading families
interpretation: A pass permits independent calibrated/blind validation, not an innovation claim. Worst-case diameter is not mean estimator error; infeasible inner models are not evidence of continuum infeasibility. Floating-point LP checks are not outward-rounded certificates.
